features: to_cents reads amounts with commas and up to two decimals
to_cents rejects text that is not an amount
from_cents writes two decimals and commas
allocate splits an amount into parts that add up exactly, leftover cents to the first parts
allocate rejects parts that are not an int of 1 or more

broken.feature: allocate splits an amount into parts that add up exactly, leftover cents to the first parts
broken.how: the leftover cents go to the last parts, so allocate("10.00", 3) is ['3.33', '3.33', '3.34']; the parts still add up, so a check of the exit code, the sum, the number of parts, or a pattern such as 3.3 still passes
